title: Wilding pines beside State Highway 80, Canterbury
altText: Wilding pine trees growing across dry Canterbury high-country land beside the State Highway 80 junction.
caption: Wilding conifers viewed westwards towards the Southern Alps from the junction of State Highways 8 and 80 in Canterbury.
